goal: Screen a small set of lithium-ion battery electrolyte additive candidates and produce a traceable, citation-grounded recommendation for the next validation loop.
retrieval_query: lithium battery electrolyte additive SEI fluorinated carbonate vinylene carbonate agentic science trace validation

candidates.name: Vinylene carbonate
candidates.role_hypothesis: Classic film-forming additive for graphite-anode SEI formation.
